dataset: World 3 Bahasa Inggris Wajib Chapter 1 - Misi 12 (Job Application & Captions)
purpose: Bank soal fondasi (Layer 1) untuk literasi teks fungsional (World 3).

questions.question:
A picture in a magazine shows a group of volunteers planting trees in a barren area. Below the picture, it says: 'Local heroes taking real action against climate change in West Java.'
What is the main function of the text below the picture?
options: To give a detailed explanation of climate change.
To provide context and brief information about the picture.
To persuade readers to donate money for trees.
To tell a fictional story about West Java.
questions.answer: To provide context and brief information about the picture.
questions.explanation: The text is a 'caption'. The primary social function of a caption is to provide context, description, or brief information explaining what is happening in a picture or photograph.
questions.provenance: Soal orisinal identifikasi fungsi sosial teks caption (K13).
questions.subject: Bahasa Inggris

questions.question:
Read this excerpt from an application letter:
'I am writing to express my interest in the Web Developer position listed on your company website. With a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and three years of experience in front-end development, I am confident in my ability to contribute effectively to your team.'
Which part of an application letter is this excerpt?
questions.explanation: The excerpt clearly states the purpose of the letter (applying for a specific position) and briefly summarizes the applicant's core qualifications, which is the standard structure for the opening paragraph (body) of an application letter.
questions.provenance: Soal orisinal drill K13 untuk mengenali struktur generik surat lamaran kerja.
questions.subject: Bahasa Inggris

questions.question:
Excerpt from an application letter:
'While my previous roles were primarily in graphic design, I have spent the last 18 months independently managing social media campaigns for local NGOs, increasing their engagement by 40%. Therefore, I believe my transition into digital marketing will bring a fresh, visual-first perspective to your agency.'
What is the applicant implicitly trying to achieve in this paragraph?
options: To apologize for not having a formal degree in digital marketing.
To reframe a potential weakness (lack of direct agency experience) into a unique strength.
To complain about their previous graphic design job.
To demand a higher salary due to their NGO experience.
questions.answer: To reframe a potential weakness (lack of direct agency experience) into a unique strength.
questions.explanation: The applicant acknowledges a non-traditional background (graphic design instead of digital marketing) but immediately bridges it with relevant independent experience (NGOs) and frames it as a unique advantage ('visual-first perspective'). This is a strategic move to overcome a perceived lack of experience.
questions.provenance: Soal orisinal penalaran literasi bahasa tingkat tinggi (TKA Bonus) yang menuntut analisis intensi penulis (author's purpose) dari teks formal.
